description: Confirm a purchase prepared with request_acquisition, once the buyer has seen it and agreed. It reserves the work and returns the bank transfer instructions: an account opened for this purchase only, and a reference to write on the transfer. Takes the confirmation code, the same buyer email and the buyer's acceptance of the licence and the terms of sale; every buyer also agrees to immediate delivery. Confirming twice returns the same instructions.

accepts_licence.description: true only if the buyer has seen the licence and accepts it

accepts_terms.description: true only if the buyer has seen the terms of sale and accepts them

buyer_email.description: The same buyer email the purchase was prepared with

consents_immediate_delivery.description: true only if the buyer agrees to immediate delivery and acknowledges that their right of withdrawal ends when the download begins (every buyer, a business too: some sole traders have that right)

name: confirm_acquisition
title: Confirm acquisition
